summary: Release and Health failed 'Nobody has changed the environment by hand' on foundation/dev: the broker and ACM-validation DNS records kept losing their comment. Cloudflare's audit log showed a second OpenTofu config (the zone inventory in crvouga/personal, provider 5.26.0) overwriting both records without a comment after each Release set it. The pubsub module no longer sets a comment, so both configs declare the same record.
